# Moodie

> A tiny, deeply configurable animated SVG face for React.

Install: npm install https://github.com/arhxam/moodie-react/releases/latest/download/moodie-react.tgz motion
Repository: https://github.com/arhxam/moodie-react
License: MIT

Minimal usage:

```tsx
import { Moodie } from "@moodie/react";
<Moodie expression="happy" color="#dfff5b" />;
```

Built-in expressions: neutral, happy, excited, sleepy, sad, worried, thinking, love, curious, surprised, focused, cheeky, dizzy, calm, wink, alert.

Shapes: circle, squircle, blob, pebble, diamond, oval, triangle, cloud, hexagon, square, drop.

Expression changes combine body and eye performances. Eye motion supports notice, glance, squint, wide, flutter, roll, vanish, orbit, doubleTake, recoil, droop, and shake cues; parent-canvas tracking; hover recognition; idle choreography; right-click blinking; and double-right-click shape cycling.

Configure eyeMotion.expressionTriggers to map expressions to cues or `none`. Defaults include cheeky→roll, dizzy→orbit, surprised→recoil, sleepy→droop, and alert→doubleTake. Imperative refs expose animateEyes(cue); newer calls interrupt from the current pose and always settle at full opacity. Keep disruptive cues such as vanish opt-in for idle playback.

Main props: expression, defaultExpression, expressions, expressionOrder, onExpressionChange, shape, color, eyeColor, size, eyeScale, eyeDistance, turn, flip, motion, spring, expressionMotion, eyeMotion, blink, pointer, auto, gaze, gazeLimit, clickAction, reaction, reducedMotion, ariaLabel.

Use pointer.target="parent" for full-canvas gaze, eyeMotion.contextMenuBlink for right-click blinking, and doubleContextShapeCycle with defaultShape (or controlled shape plus onShapeChange) for double-right-click shape cycling.

Controlled interaction:

```tsx
const [expression, setExpression] = useState("curious");
<Moodie expression={expression} onExpressionChange={setExpression} clickAction="random" />;
```

See the repository's docs/llm-guide.md for the complete model, accessibility rules, custom geometry, and framework notes.
